spec.description: T-67 variant: 5 case reference houses around FHNW Campus Dreispitz plus one Allschwil-sized indoor pool at the campus. Generated by scripts/make_local_fleet.py from config/fleet/local/dreispitz.json.

sources.centre: Approximate position of FHNW Campus Dreispitz, Freilager-Platz, Münchenstein: TODO(source), not from a geodata source; display only
sources.rings_m: Scenario value (T-67): houses alternate over two rings of 300/600 m; display only
sources.houses.count: Scenario value (T-67): 5 houses (user choice: few houses next to one large flat consumer)
sources.cell_id: cap-bs: case Basel weather cell, used for forecasts (data/raw/swiss-grid/SOURCE.md); the campus is about 3 km from the case coordinates
sources.weather_ref: data/raw/open-meteo/basel-2025-hourly.csv, case weather (data/raw/open-meteo/SOURCE.md), used for every site
sources.design_heating_kw: Houses: 10 kW, case reference house (config/reference-house.json); pool: 0, its heat is modelled as a flat daily amount
sources.hot_water_kwh_per_day: Houses: 12 kWh/day, case (config/reference-house.json); pool: 627,000 kWh/a / 365 = 1,717.8 kWh/day, Hallenbad Allschwil after renovation (data/raw/sites/site-types.csv, https://pubdb.bfe.admin.ch/de/publication/download/816, accessed 2026-11-20); flat shape is synthetic (BFE guide: indoor-pool demand year-round, weakly weather dependent)
sources.tank_kwh: 35 kWh, case reference house; pool: same 35 kWh, synthetic (the pool water as a buffer is not modelled)
sources.tank_initial_kwh: 0: tank starts empty as in Core
sources.electricity_price_chf_per_kwh: Münchenstein H4 2026, Primeo Netz AG, 31.977 Rp./kWh (data/raw/elcom/municipalities-2026/H4.json)
sources.server_count: Houses: 4, case reference house; pool: 20, synthetic scenario value (T-67); its flat heat could absorb 89.5 servers (71.6 kW / 0.8)
